definitions.explanation: Paid items, currency, or upgrades bought from within a smartphone game or app after the initial install. Almost always appears as part of the longer phrase アプリ{内課金|ないかきん}.

examples.japanese: {内課金|ないかきん}でアイテムを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an item via in-app purchase.

examples.japanese: アプリ{内課金|ないかきん}に{月|つき}3000{円|えん}{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I spend 3,000 yen a month on in-app purchases.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{勝手|かって}に{内課金|ないかきん}をして{請求|せいきゅう}が{大変|たいへん}なことになった。
examples.english: My child made in-app purchases without permission and the bill turned into a disaster.

notes:
Clipped from アプリ{内課金|ないかきん} ({内|ない} ('inside') + {課金|かきん} ('billing/charging')). Refers especially to game purchases of virtual currency, gacha pulls, or in-game items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アプリ{内課金|ないかきん}: in-app purchase (full phrase)
- {内課金|ないかきん}でアイテムを{買|か}う: to buy an item via in-app purchase
- {内課金|ないかきん}に{制限|せいげん}をかける: to set a limit on in-app purchases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {課金|かきん}: paid use; topping up — broader; covers any in-app spending
- ガチャ: gacha — random-draw type of in-app purchase
- {基本|きほん}{無料|むりょう}: free-to-play — the business model that relies on in-app purchases
